main_text.p: Firmamentū Sabinianorū, qui causam sine qua non, urgebāt: At meum [?]es, sine meo facto, fieri tuum non potuit. quare lex illa sic accipiēda est, nisi ex aliena materia fit facta. D. An species ex aliena materia facta, eius fit, cuius est materia. Caius eò tandem vetum affirmat, ut distingui res debverint. aut enim rem ad pristinā materiam reduci posse, veluti si ex ære, alióve metallo facta fit: aut non pos-se, veluti si ex marmore, vel ebore, vel saxo. si non possit, forestatuarij: si possit, domini materiæ. Cuius opinionis hāc opinor esse ratione, quia si

page.notes: Catchword "si" is in the foot right. The word after "ęs" in the first line is unclear; the glyph may be a ligature or a mark and is copied as [?]. Printed "debuerint" was normalised to "debverint" by the u/v rule. Long s has been read as plain s throughout.
